name: The Crossing Shopping Center
summary: The Crossing Shopping Center is a community retail destination conveniently located along Interstate 35 East in Lancaster, Texas. This open-air center serves the southern Dallas County area with a practical mix of everyday retail and dining options for local families and commuters.
demographics: The Crossing Shopping Center serves the Lancaster, Texas community in southern Dallas County, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban area. The trade area draws from a diverse demographic mix with a significant proportion of households earning between $40,000 and $75,000 annually, including young families with children and established homeowners. Shoppers typically visit for convenient access to everyday necessities, grocery shopping, and casual dining options, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when families run errands together.
description: The Crossing Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination strategically located along North Interstate 35 East Road in Lancaster, Texas, serving the southern Dallas County area. This open-air shopping center provides convenient access to a variety of everyday retail and service options for local residents and commuters traveling along the I-35E corridor. With its accessible location and practical tenant mix, The Crossing has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination where families can complete their weekly errands and enjoy casual dining options. The center benefits from high visibility along one of the area's major transportation arteries, making it a convenient stop for the growing Lancaster community. Operating daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM, The Crossing Shopping Center continues to serve as an important retail hub for southern Dallas County residents seeking quality shopping experiences close to home.
